# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: This ship has now become a refuge for escaped $$奴隷$$s and the $$弱者$$,
this very ark carried the ancestors of every animal
to this land; it is said to have been their cradle.
Are you all right, $$ルピルピ$$!?
For now, please take her to my room.
(For those who wear $$悪魔の鎧$$, it is an inescapable fate...)
(Like mine, this woman's life-force too does not seem likely to last much longer...)
